faq.approval_a: No. Orders prepared by representatives reach the supplier only after the store approves that exact version.
faq.approval_q: Can a representative place an order without the store?
faq.data_a: Each company's data is isolated at the database level, access is permission-based and every sensitive action is logged.
faq.delivery_a: The supplier prepares and delivers. WESAL tracks the status, the driver details and the store's confirmation of received quantities.
faq.fees_a: Stores and representatives start free. Suppliers choose a subscription plan that fits their size.
faq.languages_a: Arabic, English, Urdu and Hindi — for screens, notifications and PDF documents.
faq.payments_a: No. Stores pay suppliers directly. WESAL records collection status and commission payout evidence only.
faq.reps_any_company_a: Yes, as long as each company has issued a valid authorization covering the products and areas.
faq.reps_any_company_q: Can a representative work with several companies?
faq.what_a: A B2B marketplace that connects stores, sales representatives and suppliers to manage ordering, approvals, delivery tracking and commissions in one place.
